# lokalise_team_user_group_project (Resource)

A single project's assignment to a Lokalise team user group. This resource manages exactly the assignment it created; it never removes any other project assigned to the group. Creating it for a project that is already assigned fails; import the existing assignment instead.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "lokalise_project" "marketing" {
  name                = "Marketing site"
  base_language_iso   = "en"
  deletion_protection = false
}

resource "lokalise_team_user_group" "french_translators" {
  team_id = 123456
  name    = "French translators"
  role_id = 5

  languages = {
    reference     = ["en"]
    contributable = ["fr"]
  }
}

resource "lokalise_team_user_group_project" "marketing" {
  team_id    = 123456
  group_id   = lokalise_team_user_group.french_translators.group_id
  project_id = lokalise_project.marketing.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (Number) Lokalise team user group ID. Changing it forces a new resource.
- `project_id` (String) Lokalise project ID to assign to the group. Changing it forces a new resource.
- `team_id` (Number) Lokalise team ID. Changing it forces a new resource.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `team_id:group_id:project_id`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import lokalise_team_user_group_project.marketing <team_id>:<group_id>:<project_id>
```
